text: Natatia King was a child of a dysfunctional and abusive family, until her death at the hands of a drug dealer. In death, she became a wraith of the Penitent Legion.
Falar was a agent of the Knights of the Shield who operated throughout the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.
Nathaniel is the sixth generation Brujah Baron of Carlisle during the Medieval era. He was one of the conspirators against Mithras' rule and destroyed the powerful Aethelwulf.

Nathashen'Ka is a powerful and physically-twisted Tzimisce and the leader of the Warsaw Sabbat during the Victorian period. She pushed the local Sabbat against the Camarilla led by Prince Henryk Rzegotka and the elder Damerad Yanick.

Ninmug is one of the names that are written in the tombs of the Aralu, the darkest and most hidden secret of the Tal’Mahe’Ra. Even the Rawi, the historians of the Tal’Mahe’Ra, do not know who truly sleeps within those tombs. Perhaps these creatures are mummies; they may be Antediluvians, or even the sires of the Third Generation; or they may be ancient mages who have unlocked the secrets of immortality. Whatever they are, their presence radiates power.
The Faith Killer was an enchanted axe created by the power of sheer will and denial of divine powers.

Nichodemus Mulhouse (sometimes spelled Nicodemus) was a powerful sorcerer who served as the Master Archivist to the Council of Nine Mystic Traditions, running the Archives on Horizon until that Realm's destruction.

Notulf is a powerful vampire active in Aachen during the Medieval period. He was the Prince of the city until being overthrown by the Brujah Cocceius in 1400. In 1800, he was freed by the Nosferatu Volker after two centuries in prison.
Our Lady is a Spirit God-Form who is the manifestation of women and femininity.
The Fane of Lolth was a underground temple dedicated to the Queen of Spiders located beneath Rothé Valley on the Sword Coast North.
Paints-Your-Nightmares is a male Shadow Lord Theurge. He appears in Rage.
Peter Kleist is a powerful Ventrue and childe of Gustav Breidenstein. He acted as his blood brother Wilhelm's bodyguard in West Berlin, and later forcibly joined the Setite Methuselah Nefertiti.
Peter Wu is a New World Order Operative that has been turned into an Anakim.
The Fallen Temple, also known as the Temple of the Broken Hammer, was a cult once devoted to Tyr responsible for many crises in the Utter East until the late 14 century.
Powell is a British Nosferatu, childe of the methuselah Trajan.
Qingu, the Visage of Radiance is the Apocalyptic Form of the Namaru who specialize in the Lore of Radiance.
Randel Portman or The Fireman was the first nova known by the public to have erupted following the explosion of the Galatea.
Falhnen Battlescar was a fighter and a cleric from the town of Longsaddle, active in the 14 century DR.
Ralph is an Unseelie Redcap Wilder in the Kingdom of Pacifica.
Raiden is the Japanese god of thunder and a member of the Amatsukami.
Raíz, born Martina Santiago Guzman, is a 10th generation vampire of the Hecata clan, from the Lamia bloodline.
Ezeddeen was a corrupt Netherese fighter who served as an Underchief at Constabulary Branch Two in Eileanar before its destruction in .
Rannulf is an eleventh generation Nosferatu of medieval Jerusalem.
Remus is the brother of Rome's legendary founder Romulus, and the founder of the Julii vampire clan. He was purportedly sired by the Goddess Venus herself.
The Malkavian antitribu currently known as Rodolfo is one of the greatest living explorers of the Dementation Discipline of his clan.

Fallen dragon sword knots were ancient dragoncraft charms created from the bones of killed dragons by the best craftsmen of the Realms in the land of the Red Wizards – Thay, in the Unapproachable East, available to adventurers of Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR.
Roger Goldman is vampire that ended up in Savannah after the Siege of Atlanta.
Rodrigo is a powerful Brujah of the Medieval era, and a scholar of the Road of the Beast.

Roarke is the final boss of Ashes to Ashes, a former thrall of Lodin and an independent ghoul. He fed on the blood of the Methuselah Menele for decades, becoming highly powerful and setting his revenge against the Prince into motion.

The Fallen Axe Bridge was a massive bridge in the region of Icespire Peak, spanning a deep ravine between Windchill Reach and the White Crags. The landmark was formed from the colossal greataxe once wielded by the frost giant Lakkar during his war against the dwarves of Clan Icehammer.

Sam Noblood is said to be the founder of the changeling Summer Court. The stories of the Court claim that he took a branch topped with autumn leaves and hunted down Summer, as autumn was the only thing that Summer would fear. Eventually, Noblood cornered the season and made the bargain founding the Court in exchange for peace. As his tenacity and strength of arms would bode well in conflict with the True Fae, the season agreed.
Sabanu is a sixth generation Nosferatu and the sire of the anathema Rabbat. Sabanu was an agent of Baba Yaga in the 13th century who Embraced an aged Rabbat who wished for actual death.
Rusticus is a 10th generation Gargoyle. In service to Mara regent of Jerusalem in the Dark Ages.
Faurael Blackhammer was a human fighter and the Lord Protector of the town of Triboar in the Dessarin Valley in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Rudolf Berg is a tenth generation Nosferatu of the Frankfurt Rhine-Main Camarilla.
Samuel Haight was one-of-a-kind man in World of Darkness. Former Kinfolk, former ghoul, former Mage, former Skin Dancer, currently an ashtray somewhere in the ruins of Stygia.
Sarrasine is a degenerate vampire who currently presides as the Prince of Sydney, Australia.

The Fellowship of the Purple Staff was a group of like-minded priests and other faithful who united in the , to settle the area of the Gulthmere Forest and other lands north of Turmish and turn it into a civilized theocracy they called the "Holy Realm".
Duke Scalock is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Leanhaun in the Kingdom of Willows.
Samuel Tucker is a Fire-Touched beta of the Howl to Mock the Dead Pack in Colorado.
Sandra Oshe is the Ghoul of Brennon Thornhill. She was an Olympic powerlifter and is now the personal security guard of the Ventrue alongside her boyfriend, Kyle Ryper.

Fenthick Moss was a half-elf cleric of Tyr and the deceased fiancé of Aribeth de Tylmarande in the mid-14 century DR. The pair were known as "the very Sword and Scales of Tyr". He was a colleague to the false Helmite Desther Indelayne.

The Screamers have ever been present since the explosion of Little Boy. The most common belief held by those who have encountered these creatures is that they are fragmented sections of wraiths who have not been able to locate the remainders of their Corpus. Many believe that this accidental fragmentation has left the Screamers locked into an endless struggle to find the rest of themselves and coalesce. Others feel that they are simply beasts of the Tempest who have been vomited forth through the Nihil into the Shadowlands.
Sarapion is an ancient Laibon methuselah that terrorizes Mogadishu during the Dark Ages.
Serotonin is an angel charged with beginning the plague that will end humanity, and it has wide latitude to do so. Its mission does not end until humanity is no longer capable of sustaining itself.
Fatal Touch, the favored weapon of Kelemvor, the Faerûnian god of the dead, was a +5 ghost touch holy undead bane bastard sword.

The Sheriff was LaCroix's personal bodyguard and enforcer. The Sheriff's towering size, monstrous visage and perpetual muteness (as well as his slavish devotion to his Prince) make him one of the most feared Kindred in Los Angeles.
Shahid, also known as the Keeper of the Word, is an 8th generation Nosferatu resident of Cairo.

King Solomon was a legendary figure and the monarch of ancient Israel. A mage of tremendous power, who is well remembered for being king of Israel as well as a pioneer in the binding of spirits, djinn and similar otherworldly entities.
The Farlong house was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North. It belonged to Daeghun Farlong.

Called the Maiden of Plagues by others, whatever the entity’s name is, the Methuselah and Ethernal of Sothis is the undeniable hub of all Setite attention in Cairo, and rightfully so. At well over 5000 years old, it instills the proper amount of terrified reverence within those who come to attend it at court. Many have seen the crippling havoc that the creature can wreak with but a thought. All in attendance have come to believe that their Sleeping Lord sleeps in order to maintain dreaming contact with its sleeping grandsire — Set himself — and that it is the only one, of all the Father’s children, to receive this precious blessing.
Sokto is the huge proto-human form between the Homid and Crinos states of the Bastet.
Solveig Larssen is the Proxy of the Legions, the psychokinetic order.

"Farsann" was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr. A farsann was responsible for managing the domestic staff of a noble house as well as for seeing to the planning and transpiring of feasts and ceremonies. A farsann was an inferior position to a sammafar. They oversaw the work of the corlanns.
Soldat, born Benjamin Harris, is a City Gangrel who survived World War II and joined the Sabbat. He is death with fangs, and has a position in a respected Black Hand pack known as 25:17.
Spring-Heeled Jack is a mysterious creature existing in the Chronicles of Darkness. He features in the SAS A Night With Jack.
Stefan Rutigar is a powerful Brujah of East Berlin, and the childe of Ilse Baensch.
Faril Laheralson was a male human fighter and ranger and the Oversword of a 100-strong contingent of Purple Dragons based in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s and early 1370s DR.
A Kwannon-jin of the Eastern Hsien, the Suijen are elemental nobles; Kamuii Shinma of the element of Water. They are often mistakenly referred to as Changelings.

Strong Matthew is a kithless Ogre who acts as an enforcer for Grandfather Thunder. He commonly works alongside his motley, the Apostolic Knights, which is composed of Mark Stalwart, John St. Elmo, Quiet Luke, and himself.
Subtle Storm is a Storm Lord Ithaeur member of the Silver Syndicate Pack in Colorado.
Farouk Abd al-Bazan was an efreeti and leader of the Sword Dancers sect of the Everlasting in 1367 DR.

Sun Rises Gleaming was the eldest and strongest of the Bull-People of Neolithic times. At some point, he and his people became aware that the Wise had taken the heart of the Old God Bull and demanded it be given to them. A being of great wisdom, Sun nonetheless had an ill temper and became enraged upon the demands not being met.
The Stormcat is a once-mighty servant of Grandfather Thunder, most often in his aspect as Vahagn the straw-thief.

Tarjei Hardrule was a mighty Philodox and Jarl of the Get of Fenris. He fell in battle in 803 CE as his Sept of the Valiant Hammer of Vengeance was taken by a rival group of Fenrir. His harsh punishments and judgments of those in his sept had left them weakened and could not defend against them, but Tarjei himself refused to submit and died fighting. For all his sins, he is remembered as a great warrior, and in fact his skull was crafted into a fetish, the Head of Hardrule.

A fang dagger was an enchanted dagger that, when drawn, appeared as a 6" emerald-green serpent. While it appeared as a normal blade when sheathed, it otherwise had no sharp edge, could not be used to parry or defend in combat, or used in any utilitarian manner and could only barely pierce the skin of an opponent. It did however inject venom when it struck a victim, in the same manner as the bite of a snake. The venom within the blade was never exhausted, as long as the head of the dagger was not severed. These daggers were a favored weapons of thieves and wizards of Thay, as well as lands like Murghôm, Semphar, Raurin, and Durpar but were quite uncommon in the North.

Tanner was a Gangrel, sire of Ramona and the childer of Horrock. He Embraced Ramona and then abandoned her, secretly keeping watch over her from Los Angeles to New York City. In 1999, he saved her multiple times but was eventually destroyed while facing the crazed Leopold.
Sweet Sorrow is a Haunter and the head of the Haunter Alliance known as the Bedlameers.

Terence Gardener was a Ventrue and the Scourge of London. As a mortal, he served as a minion to the gangsters. One of the first Kindred to do real harm to Operation Antigen's forces, he terrorized them with his extreme style of violence. While several agents of Operation Antigen fell during his violent attack, so did he.

The Fellowship of Bowyers and Fletchers was a guild in the city Waterdeep made up of the city's bow-and-arrow crafters, still young by 1357 DR. Despite the high demand for their wares, they maintained a carefree outlook and were not overly concerned with intense mercantile competition.

A close-knit group of four women who are powerful psychics and mediums. They use these powers in the acquisition of influence, money and power. The Serpentines maintain a residence and an art gallery in Phoenix, Arizona. Though most of the time these women travel throughout the United States, maintaining contacts and developing new ones, catering to wealthy industry leaders and special interests who can pay for their political manipulation. Usually this involves information gathering, both mundane industrial espionage or more mystical techniques, for instance using wraiths. In rare circumstances they bind a ghost and have him possess a person using Puppetry to perform a specific act. For instance pushing a button to indicate a positive vote where the victim might have voted negatively.

The Seven Conflagrations, known as Imin U'izich to the Forsaken, Izikhul-farakh to the Pure or as "The Blister Man", is a Spirit/Spirit-Ridden from Chicago. The Seven Conflagrations is spirit-claiming various mortals (Daniel Rebworth, Cesar Flores, etc.) while attempting to reawaken the Great-Fire-Spirit. In doing so, it often destroys the bodies of the Claimed in its quest and the seven fire elemental spirits merge with human minds.
The Slumbering Giant is an epithet for an ancient Gangrel methuselah that lies in torpor under the Simon Fraser University at Vancouver.
Feldepost's Inn was an old establishment located in the town of Beregost on the Sword Coast in the mid-to-late 14 and late 15 centuries DR.
Thick Hide Jack is a Metis Theurge Children of Gaia. He appears in Rage.

Shaman Tom "Laughing Eagle" Smithson, Master of Spirit, Life and Time, held the Seat of Spirit for the Dreamspeakers on the Council of Nine Mystic Traditions prior to the War in Heaven. His fate following the war and the Avatar Storm is unknown.
Tomas Chavez is a Storm Lord Elodoth, member of the Last Light pack in Santa Fe, New Mexico.
Fenberry was an edible berry, also known as cranberry, found throughout Faerûn and Sword Coast, often growing in colder climates and swamps. The berries were often used as an arcane component.
Tomlynn Sinclair is an eighth generation Nosferatu and the Archon of the powerful Karl Schrekt.
These giants of the fae possess incredible strength and determination. Once they give their loyalty, nothing can sway them from those they have sworn to protect. Honor walks in their footsteps.
Truck Basher is one of three Garou who rescued Black-Mane-That-Breaks-The-Spiral during his battle with the Corelli Brothers.
Fencer's Grace were sets of light enchanted armor especially favored by duelists and brigands of the Sword Coast.

Triage is an angel in the form of a gigantic lion whose purpose is to make an efficient decision. It is known to have been involved in a mix-up regarding an artifact of the God-Machine, the Flag of Elam.
Tub of Flesh, formerly known as Hans, is a liquefied Nosferatu vampire elder. His current state is the result of the twisted use of Vicissitude by Sascha Vykos.

Tsar Bomba is one of two signature characters of the Zeka Lineage in Promethean: The Created. He is one of five Zeka Progenitors, and the one to give the line its name. He was created when Dr. Mikhail Alessandrovich Elizaro was sent to the military installation on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Novaya_Zemlya Novaya Zemlya] to study the effects of radiation on the prisoners there (the Russian word for prisoner being zeky). Dr. Elizaro has previously found a copy of the notes of Doctor Victor Frankenstein, and decided to link Doctor Frankenstein's principles to those of nuclear radiation, as he understood it. He proceeded to make a body from the dead prisoners, and then used the blast from a nuclear test to imbue it with Divine Fire. Tsar Bomba remained with his creator until the authorities came to shut down, at which point he escaped, in the process "subjecting the scientist and his would-be captors to a spontaneous, lethal blast of something similar, but not quite identical, to radiation". The scientists, including Dr. Elizaro, would die within weeks of fast-spreading cancers. Tsar Bomba, not yet known by that name, would remain on the island for a while, becoming a "boogeyman" for those around. He, in turn, watched and learned from him. Very early on, he decided he never wanted to become human, as he found them fragile and weak. What he wanted, instead, was to control them. When humans saw them, they only ever experienced terror, which would only allow for partial control o
The Fang of Zehir was an enchanted sword wielded by the yuan-ti known as the Herald of Zehir. It contained some of his power.
The Unmade are horrifying entities - mages that have managed to enter the Arcadia of the Gentry and have been fundamentally changed by it.
Twister Cross is a Storm Lord Rahu member of the Jagged Sky's Pack in Colorado.
Umberto is a Nosferatu of the New York Warren and a lieutenant of the Elder Calebros. He reports to his master the events surrounding the arrival of the prophet Anatole in New York City.
Fatzon Axemaiden was a dwarven fighter and once, a member of the Hearth Guard, active in the 14 century DR.
]] Vasana was the Three-Hooded, Vasana the Emerald, Vasana the Terrible. Of all the warriors of this bright Age, Vasana is the first among them.
The Visigoth was an ancient Gangrel Methuselah that lay in Torpor beneath Sevilla.
Violents is the Ogre bodyguard to the Hobgoblin known as Ambrosia.
Fel Suparra was a cultist and a member of the Knights of the Black Sword that arose in Caer-Dineval during the late 15 century DR.

The Weaver, also known as Grandmother Spider, is one of the three primordial cosmic powers comprising the Triat, alongside the Wyld and the Wyrm. Originally responsible for imposing order upon the Wyld's creations, the Weaver gave form and structure to existence, establishing the laws through which the universe could function. Her work was essential to the natural cycle, allowing things to exist in stable forms before the Wyrm brought them to their appointed conclusions. However, the Weaver's growing obsession with permanence eventually led her to imprison the Wyrm within the Pattern Web, disrupting the balance of the Triat and contributing to the corruption of Creation. The Weaver is commonly associated with order, law, knowledge, science, technology, and Stasis. Although traditionally portrayed as female by the Garou, her true nature transcends conventional identity, and other supernatural traditions describe her through different names and manifestations. Her influence extends throughout the Tellurian, particularly within human civilization, where the development of increasingly complex societies and technologies has strengthened her position relative to the other members of the Triat. Unlike the corrupted Wyrm, whose influence is frequently associated with obvious destruction, the Weaver's activities are often indistinguishable from the ordinary processes through which civilizations develop. Although her gifts have enabled humanity to survive and prosper, her madness thre

Wani, also known as Dragon Kings, Dragon Princes, or Lu Lung, are terms used by the Nagah to describe the great dragon-spirits that act as patrons to their kind, the only spirits who know the Sacred Secret.

The Walker of Paths was a Forest-Wise who acted as a vessel for Luna in the Neolithic Era, sometime in the 5th millennium BCE. He lost himself in a place of shattered Time and subsequently traveled from village to village attempting to spur people into constructing a great Sanctuary. The very presence of the Walker of Paths spread a virulent meme that inhibited victims' desire to leave said Sanctuary.
Feather leather armor was a type of enchanted light armor, used in the 15 century DR.
Wulfgar the Reaver was the vampiric master of Iceland during the Middle Ages.
Zara Slatikov is one of the few Koldun of the Sabbat and a paragon on the Path of Metamorphosis. She helped form the modern Path of Enlightenment at the Black Monastery.

Zelios is a Nosferatu master mason and accomplished architect among the damned, famed for the construction of the geomantic web to bind Kupala into the Transylvanian soil. The Clan Curse of the Nosferatu has afflicted him in a way to reflect his passion for stone and architecture: Zelios's skin and eyes have become as gray as the stone he builds with. His features are almost unnaturally angular.
Fank was an ogre mercenary who worked alongside his companions on the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.
Za'aphiel was a fifth generation methuselah of the Salubri Warrior Caste and the childe of Samiel.
Yuan Cho is one of the Isles of the Dragon King. Yuan Cho's Element is Fire, the Direction is South, Season is Summer, Color is Red and Spheres are Forces, Prime and Spirit.
Zara Bradley is a Brujah ancilla and actress of the London Camarilla.
Fennel was an aromatic plant often used as a spice or herb, found in kitchens from the Sword Coast to Ravens Bluff in the Vast.

is an alien race character from the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies series. He frequently appears as a villain in cartoons and video games, and wears a Roman soldier's helmet and skirt. The character has been voiced by Mel Blanc, Joe Alaskey, Bob Bergen, and Eric Bauza, among others. The character first appeared as an antagonist in the 1948 Bugs Bunny cartoon Haredevil Hare. He went on to appear in four more cartoons produced between 1952 and 1963.
The Academy Chef is a red dragonspawn located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Aeosera is the broodmother of the stone dragons of Deepholm. She sided with Deathwing after the Cataclysm and needed regular reminding of her subservience to Therazane.
Ferostil was a warrior in the Company of the Bright Spear in the mid-14 century DR.
Aeolos is an air elemental located in the Darkwhisper Gorge in Mount Hyjal. He is probably an elemental minion of Elementalist Ortell.

__NOTOC__ Aetherion is a massive lightning revenant that resides on the broken bridge that once connected Auberdine to the ship ports. , a fanatic of the Twilight Cult, spoke highly of him, "...we will destroy Lor'danel, with Aetherion as our vanguard!" she yells before being destroyed by the player.

__NOTOC__ Ael'Yith is a nightborne elf that can be found in the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar in Azsuna. He is the leader of a group of mana-addicted nightfallen that are siphoning arcane energies from the ley line there, in the process weakening the Azurewing, a group of blue dragons who live nearby. Ael'Yith is confronted by the adventurer at the ley-ruins and engages in combat. Before fleeing, he directs his group to target the dragons directly. He later resurfaces during the attack on Azurewing Repose, utilizing his ley construct Orbyth to drain power from Senegos. Ael'Yith finally meets his end here at the hands of the adventurer.
Farloi was a bold tasloi fighter and one of the two lieutenants of the Flotilla of DEATH.
Air Warden is an unbound air elemental found in the Halls of Origination.
Airborne Priests are goblin priests located in Azshara. They were called by Horde adventurers to heal wounded soldiers. They do pilot Wings of Steel.
Aku'mai the Devourer is a hydra and the final boss of Blackfathom Deeps.
Felbris was a beholder who made his home in Gauntlgrym on the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR.

Akaari Shadowgore is a man'ari eredar and one of Sargeras' deadliest assassins. She wields the Fangs of the Devourer, a pair of deadly daggers which Mephistroth had crafted from the fangs of Goremaw, Sargeras' personal hound. Subtlety rogues seeking to claim the Fangs confront Akaari at her citadel in the Twisting Nether.

Alleria Windrunner was a ranger-captain of Silvermoon who led her rangers under the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War. She was also the head scout of the Alliance Expedition to Draenor. Alleria and her lover Turalyon disappeared after the planet was torn apart and were not heard from for many years. They resurfaced during the final war against the Burning Legion, having been members of the Army of the Light for a thousand years from their perspective, as time passes differently inside the Twisting Nether. After absorbing the power of the dark naaru L'ura in the ruins of Eredath on Argus, Alleria became the first void elf, and now leads others like her in the Alliance following the defeat of the Legion. Alleria was one of the main protagonists in Tides of Darkness, Beyond the Dark Portal, Legion and The War Within.
__NOTOC__ Alkalinius is a water elemental located in Stormsong Valley during Faction Assaults.

The Feast of Lanterns, or Lunar Festival, was an annual week-long festival held in Shou Lung and Kozakura and celebrated in the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North as of the late 15 century DR. It took place in the month of Tsou of the Kara-Turan calendar during the first new moon of the calendar year.
Aldroxia is a black dragonspawn located in the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
Algeth'ar Freshscales are dracthyr located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Amani'shi Flame Casters are forest trolls found in Zul'Aman.
Felrenden was a valley on the western end of the the Sword Mountains, where Ieirithymbul was.
Amani Eagle Spirit can be found in Zul'Aman. Eagle form of the Zul'jin encounter. He is the spirit of Akil'zon, the Amani's Loa.
Alystros the Verdant Keeper is an immense skytalon who is charge of the Emerald Dragonshrine's aerial defenses. It is implied by Nishera the Garden Keeper that he will be reborn.
Amaukwa is a rylak found circling counterclockwise in the skies above Moonflower Valley in .

Image:Fighter BGIII.png|5e symbol of the fighter. Image:Fighter Icon.png|4e symbol of the fighter. Fighters were bold warriors and weapon masters trained in the art of war. A skilled fighter defined the front line of battle, breaking through enemy ranks and holding the line while their allies maneuvered. All fighters were trained to use virtually any armor or weapon the situation required but most fighter were students of a particular martial tradition, such as archery or combat magic.
__NOTOC__ Ambassador Infernus is a fire elemental found in Angor Fortress in the Badlands. He oversees the Shadowforge clan's excavation of Uldaman.

Amorphic Cognitors are creatures reminiscent of merciless ones that appear to come out of the . They are seen killing and mind-controlling the goblins, ogres and pale orcs along the shore of the Spires of Arak.

Anara is a kyrian spirit healer located at the Bear's Head, Azshara. She is met by players during the quest Easy is Boring. She is in love with the blue dragon Azuregos. Many years later, Azuregos spent a great time in seclusion in the Nexus trying to find a way to tear barriers of realms in order to bring her back. When the way to the Shadowlands was opened, he hoped to find a solution, but he found only more questions.

The Firecam full-plate armor was the personal suit of armor of Sir Keldorn Firecam. It was designed specifically for him, so very few others could wear it. It was a +1 full plate armor that granted the wearer to ability to move freely through hindrances such as webs, as well as boosted resistances to effects that assailed them.
Anaha Witherbreath is an ice troll located on the expedition isles.
__NOTOC__ The Ancient Charscale is a flamewaker lieutenant of that can be found within Ragnaros' Reach of the Molten Front.
__NOTOC__ The Ancient Firelord is one of ' lieutenants that can be found within Ragnaros' Reach of the Molten Front.
Filiare () was a retired fighter who ran the Inn of the Dripping Dagger in the Trades Ward of Waterdeep by 1368 DR and through 1373 DR.

.]] One of the toughest types of ancient, Ancients of War (also spelled ancients of war) are mighty nature elementals often found defending night elf settlements such as Darnassus, or supporting Alliance forces in battle. Embodied in these ancient guardians are the spirits of courage and determination that are necessary to propel the will of the night elves. Calling upon the long-forgotten energies of conflicts from ages past, these guardians provide a link to the brutal side of nature and the cycle of life and death that rules all creation. During the third war these ancients were in charge of training Archers and Huntresses and the assembling of Ballista and Glaive Throwers, as well as assisting in research regarding the abilities of those groups. In more recent times they have been called into action to aid the Alliance in battle-torn zones such as Alterac Valley and Ashran.
The Ancient Rune Giant is a rune giant located, as part of the Thorim encounter, in Ulduar.
__NOTOC__ The Ancient Smoldering Behemoth is a molten giant officer of . It can be found within Ragnaros' Reach in the Molten Front.
Fire shield, or fireshield, also known as Dragonflame mantle during the Spellplague, was an evocation spell used to immolate the caster in protective and offensive flames.

Andormu is a dragon of the bronze dragonflight. He can be found in both adult and child elven forms, at the same time, in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. He is the brother of Nozari, whom he stands next to (in both forms), and also co-leader of Keepers of Time.
__NOTOC__ Anima-Starved Wyrms are etherwyrms located in Garden of Respite in Bastion. Two of them enter Korinna's Reliquary after the Vesper of Remembrance has been rung.

The anubisaths are titan-forged giants made of obsidian. Originally assigned by Highkeeper Ra to safeguard the fortresses of Uldum and Ahn'Qiraj, the ones guarding the latter were eventually enslaved by the qiraji.
Firebead Elvenhair was a mage from Beregost who traveled the Sword Coast in search of books for the sages at Candlekeep during the mid-to-late 4 century DR.

Arcanist Doan was a human mage located in the Athenaeum section of the Scarlet Monastery Library. Once a member of the Knights of the Silver Hand, he joined the Scarlet Crusade following the Third War and was considered one of the most powerful mages of the Crusade. Years later, he was eliminated by adventurers sent to weaken the defense of the monastery. A living version of Doan can still be seen in Old Hillsbrad Foothills.
__NOTOC__ Arcanist Lylandre is a nightborne located in the Twilight Vineyards in Suramar. She is surrounded by her protective arcane, fel, fire, and frost crystals.

When the Alliance sent an expedition to Draenor in order to finish the Horde once and for all, a group of Kirin Tor wizards led by Archmage Vargoth established a base in the heart of the Laughing Skull Clan territory. They called it Kirin'Var Village; however, shortly after they settled, Draenor was torn apart. The explosion sundered the land, and all that remains today is the Netherstorm. The surviving wizards remained in their villages for 17 years. Years later, Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider, along with his blood elf followers, attacked the village, wielding more power than the wizards could imagine. Archmage Vargoth ordered his comrades to retreat to the local tower; however, Kael'thas was wiser and stronger than Vargoth: In the moment that Vargoth and his men entered the tower, the Elven Prince sealed the doors with a curse to ensure that none of the wizards within could exit the Violet Tower. Despite Kael'thas' efforts, one of Vargoth's apprentices escaped. His name is Ravandwyr. Ravandwyr saw Kael'thas' plans but was unable to warn his master. With no one at his side, Ravandwyr fled to Area 52, a goblin settlement. Now that the Dark Portal has been reopened once more, Ravandwyr seeks help from brave Azerothian adventurers that cross over into Outland. Ravandwyr sends them to retrieve Archmage Vargoth's Staff from a demon named Ekkorash the Inquisitor. After a short inspection, Ravandwyr notices that Ekkorash took the staff's crystalline headpiece for use in some other tri
The Fields of the Dead were the rolling hills east of Baldur's Gate between the Winding Water and the River Chionthar on the Sword Coast.
Archmage Arugal is a former mage of Dalaran and the final boss of Shadowfang Keep.

__NOTOC__ Archmage Maenius was a powerful high elf mage that left Quel'Thalas with a large group, over a hundred years ago, in search of the ancient mysteries of Kel'theril and to find out why it was destroyed. When they found fragments of the :Crystal of Zin-Malor within the ice. It did not take long for Maenius to fall under its sway, the other elves did not notice until it was too late. The Archmage drove them to madness. The spirit of Maenius can be found at Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring still clinging to the shard he found so long ago.
Ardonu is a blue dragonspawn located in Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.

The Festival of Handras was a celebration in Suzail of the arrival of caravans from the Sword Coast in late Mirtul. During the festival, free food and drink were served while Suzail's residents inspected the latest goods.
Ariena Stormfeather is a human gryphon flight master located just south of the Lakeshire bridge in the Redridge Mountains.

Arien Highmountain was the wielder of Talonclaw several generations after the War of the Ancients. She aided her twin sister, Gardrel, in leading the Highmountain Tribe; rather than divide the tribe or place its well-being in the wrong hands, the previous chieftain had named Gardrel, who was acknowledged to be wiser and a strong diplomat, as the new chieftain, while Arien, who was the greater warrior and had an affinity for the wilds, became the Protector of the Mountain and wielder of Talonclaw. The sisters were happy with their roles, and Arien kept the tribe safe for many years, tapping into the blessing that the Wild Gods had bestowed on the weapon. She was the one to first give it the name "Talonclaw", honoring the Wild Gods her ancestors had befriended. One day, Arien and Gardrel encountered a group of night elves called the Unseen Path and led them up the slopes of a nearby mountain. As they approached the summit, Talonclaw began to glow in Arien's hands. As she instinctively held it up to the sky, a cascade of golden energy poured from the spearhead and took the shape of a great eagle. Arien and Gardrel both remembered the lore of their tribe and knew that Ohn'ahra herself had blessed the site, and they knew that it should be renamed Talon Peak. Together, the tauren and the Unseen Path built the Trueshot Lodge upon the slopes of Talon Peak, where they watched over the land and vowed to be ready for the Burning Legion's potential return. Aressa is a Lightforged draenei located at the outskirts of Stormwind City. She is training brightlances.
Filithan was a male priest of Ilmater from Bormton, Amn, in the 3rd century DR, who held the title "Revered Brother" and helped create the legendary sword Dornavver, the "Demonbane".
Aronus is a green dragon who gives transports to adventurers in most of his appearances.
Arlen Marsters is a human flight master located at Camp Everstill in Redridge Mountains.
Ascended Zealots are frost elemental ascendants located in Abyssal Depths.
Fihelis was a half-elf of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Astrid Bjornrittar is a frost vrykul quest giver located in the Storm Peaks.

The Avatar of Xolotal is a blue lightning wolf that can be found inside of the Den of Xolotal in Zuldazar. They have fought against the Kao-Tien, who appear to have been trying to subjugate their lightning powers for their own uses before being slain by the avatar as well as the Sons of Xolotal.
Azralon the Gatekeeper is a flamewaker located on the shores of Sulfuron Spire in Mount Hyjal. He is one of Ragnaros' most powerful lieutenants and is the sole gatekeeper to the Sulfuron Spire.
Firefiend was a unique magic weapon wielded by a tasked slayer genie called the Head Taker. Firefiend was one of two dangerous swords wielded by the Head Taker, with the other being Widowmaker.
Azsh'ari Frostbinders are naga located in the Eternal Palace.
Azzere the Skyblade is a rare wind serpent found patrolling the area south of Ruins of Taurajo in the Southern Barrens. It is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer.
Azurescale is a twilight drake that can be encoutered during Island Expeditions.

The Filthy Oar was a ship that was lost at sea with all hands in 1421 DR. A monument to the ship, mounted with plaques commemorating the crew members, was erected in Luskan's graveyard, and was still standing as of the 1490s DR.

Baltharus the Warborn is a black dragonflight drakonid, and appears in World of Warcraft as one of the three sub-bosses in the Ruby Sanctum. In order to shatter the Wyrmrest Accord and to crush those that would stand in the way of their master's reemergence into Azeroth, a powerful war party of the Black dragonflight, led by the fearsome twilight dragon Halion and his lieutenants Saviana Ragefire, Baltharus the Warborn and General Zarithrian, has launched an assault upon the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.

Baleroc, the Gatekeeper, is a fire elemental boss of the Firelands raid instance. He uses two Volcanospike swords as his personal weapons. The world first heroic kill on 25-man was achieved on July 7, 2011 by Method - EU-Xavius.
Baron Scaldius is a fire elemental located in the Heart of Azeroth.
A figurehead of wondrous power was a magical wood statue that granted beneficial powers to a spelljamming ship.
Baruk Stone Defender is a mogu located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Baron Blazehollow is a bound fire elemental located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Baron Ashflow is a fire elemental located in the mountains in the eastern part of Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
A figurehead of speed was a magical statue attached to spelljamming ships that increased their tactical speed. Although it made the ship faster in combat, it became more difficult to maneuver.
__NOTOC__ Baron Crustcore is an earth elemental located in the Quaking Cavern in the Waking Shores.
__NOTOC__ Baskilan is a black dragon located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores. He can also be found occasionally visiting the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken.
Beach Strider is a sea giant located on the expedition isles.
Fire lance was an evocation spell that shot forth a jet of flames that resembled the lance of a mounted warrior.

Belysra Starbreeze is a night elf priestess of the Moon who fought during the War of the Satyr. Along with the druid Ralaar, she created the Scythe of Elune, a powerful :artifact containing the power of the moon goddess Elune and of the wolf Ancient Goldrinn. In an attempt to help Ralaar tame the effects of the Pack form, they created the first worgen. They would prove extremely successful in fighting off the satyr, destroying their outposts and killing their leaders. Ralaar, however, would then turn them against Malfurion Stormrage and the night elves, forcing the archdruid to seal them within the Emerald Dream.

Beve Perenolde is the oldest child of Aiden Perenolde and his deceased wife, Isolde. She is valuable to the Syndicate as the most powerful of the few mages within the ranks. She is in her forties, of average size with blonde hair and serious brown eyes. She commonly wears mage's robes.

__NOTOC__ .]] Bishop Lazaril is a human priestess that could be found between the Aldor bank and A'dal's room on the Terrace of Light, in a camp of the Church of the Holy Light in Shattrath City. She was accompanied by paladins, priests and guards. With the concentration of Light from the Naaru of Shattrath, and the shared benedictions from the faithful, she has created holy artifacts of profound power as weapons against the Lich King's machinations. She then offered the artifacts to Alliance adventurers with the mission to deliver them to their race's faction leader, in order to be used against the floating necropolises of the Scourge Invasion.
A figurehead of blessing was a magical figurehead (a carved wooden sculpture decorating the bow of a ship).

The Black Knight's Gryphon can be found near the eastern end of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown along with its owner, The Black Knight. It is also sometimes referred to as the Black War Gryphon when The Black Knight is riding it. Players are tasked with capturing and riding the gryphon during the quest The Black Knight's Orders in order to retrieve the Stolen Tournament Invitation and Black Knight's Orders and bring them to Crusader Rhydalla. Later, the gryphon was now deceased and was used by The Black Knight in the Trial of the Champion when he first flought into the ring to kill the announcer.

The Bladespire Iceking is a massive basilisk that can be found in Daggermaw Ravine, slain by the Thunderlord clan's hunters, specifically a hunting party led by Grotan the Herald, one of the Iron Wolf's sons.
Bladesquall is a bound air elemental located in Galebroken Path in Stormheim.
Feytouched armor was a type of enchanted armor that had materials from the Feywild worked into it. They offered a level of protection comparable to that of hide or leather armor.
Blazing Elementals are fire elementals found in Searing Gorge.
Blazing Servants were fire elementals accompanying Twilight Seeker in Stormwind City and Durotar during the Elemental Unrest.

Blazing Stygia are unbound fire elementals located in Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw. They are burning hatred coalesces as Blazing Stygia that mindlessly pace back and forth, unleashing their fiery fury upon hapless souls. They spawn multiple Stygic Embers when they die.
Ferrusk was a corrupted druid that lived in and underneath the Misty Forest on the Sword Coast during the mid–14 century DR.

__NOTOC__ The Blazing Proto-Dragon is a fire-infused Primalist proto-dragon located in a scorched clearing in the northeastern part of the Ohn'ahran Plains. It was brought to the ground by a Shikaar raiding party, and adventurers need to help them kill it in order to prove themselves to the clan.
__NOTOC__ Blight Falconers are frost vrykul located in Ymirheim in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
Bloodfury Storm Witches were harpies located in the Charred Vale in Stonetalon Mountains.
Final Arbiter was an enchanted sword wielded by Sheikh Ardasir al-Darah of the Jann of the Haunted Lands.
__NOTOC__ Bloodmaul Frostbenders are ogres located at the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge. They are utilizing frost magic, and are followed around by their elemental minions, the Lesser Icelings.
Bonechewer is a rare ghostly vulture flying above the tower at Scarlet Palisade in Tirisfal Glades.
Bonecrusher Korgolath is a mo'arg brute that appears at the Legion Invasion locations.
Fire axes were aptly-named enchanted throwing axe that gained certain popularity in the late 14 century DR along the Sword Coast region.

Borrok the Devourer is a lava worm living in Frostfire Ridge. He spawns during a vignette. As you come near the Pit of the Devourer, you will encounter the following scene: :A Grimfrost Wormpriest and several Grimfrost Drudges are surrounding a Frostwolf Outrider. : :
__NOTOC__ Borrhas the Cold is a tauralus located in Windswept Aerie in Korthia.
__NOTOC__ Boulderfist Ogres are ogres of the Boulderfist clan found inside and around Boulder'gor in the Arathi Highlands.
Find the gap was a spell used to bypass armor and shields of many kinds.
Bracketzi is a red dragonspawn located at Fallingwater Overlook in Valdrakken.
Brigligos was a blue dragon who was killed in a magical accident. His name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Broodqueen Cindrix is a fire spider encountered during Island Expeditions.
Findings from the Hinterlands was a quarterly publication that covered news and goings-on about the Sword Coast and an area of the Western Heartlands.
Broodqueen Flareanae is a fire spider encountered during Island Expeditions.
Broodqueen Shuzasz is a fire spider encountered during Island Expeditions.
Broodqueen Vyl'tilac is a fire spider encountered during Island Expeditions.
Filro the Forgotten was a drow who lived alone in the Underdark in a region beneath the Sword Coast.
Brumeran of the Chillwind is the strongest chimera in Winterspring.

Brutallus is the second boss of the Sunwell Plateau raid. He is a giant pit lord who has lost his wings and has blades for hands like Kargath Bladefist. He is a hard, melee-oriented boss with high gear requirements. Brutallus can be seen on the far north in the Dead Scar outside on the Isle of Quel'Danas, being taunted by the blue dragon Madrigosa flying in the air above. When the adventurers sent by Shattered Sun Offensive enter the Sunwell Plateau and approach the Den of Iniquity, a room overlooking the Dead Scar, Brutallus fights and kills Madrigosa. After he is killed, his fel blood seeps into Madrigosa's body and raises her as Felmyst. Brutallus later returns as a world boss on the Broken Shore.
Burning Ravagers were fire elementals found in Stonetalon Mountains.
Fieschi was an upstanding Netherese fighter who helped guard the Netheril Mint in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Burning Destroyers were fire elementals found in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Burglosh the Earthbreaker was an ogre who took power of the Twilight's Hammer after Zeryxia's death. He was encountered by the Earthen Ring champions in Deepholm.
Burnosh is a fire elemental. It was to be a child of Exurotus.
Firebreak was a suit of magical plate armor found in Thorngap, a druidic circle in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Burning Guardians are unbound fire elementals located in the Arathi Highlands.
Calamity is a fire elemental located at the Slag Forge in Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
__NOTOC__ Cadrestrasz is a red dragon located at Fallingwater Overlook in Valdrakken.
Finch's leather armor was a unique set of leather armor worn by the daring half-elven bard Finch in the late 14 century DR.
Carolai Anise is a Forsaken artisan alchemy trainer located in Brill in Tirisfal Glades. According to the Deathguards, she is trying to blow her house with her alchemy.
Carl is a lava worm located at the Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena.

Catapult Drivers are earthen piloting Earthen Catapults in Deepholm. One of them is driving an Earthen Catapult to Needlerock Slag for Close Escort. He occasionally launches thunder stones at the enemies when in the catapult.
Finality, the Fall of the Sun was a powerful short sword found in the ruins of Myth Drannor in the late 14 century DR.

Charged War Golem is an iron golem summoned by to pilot while in Dun Argol in Grizzly Hills. Both Tormak the Scarred of the Horde and Raegar Breakbrow instruct adventurers to use the War Golem's powers to kill Iron Thane Furyhammer.

__NOTOC__ Char the Burning is a Draenor ancient found engaged in combat with several Grom'kar Pyros in Steamburst Cauldron in Gorgrond. Loot Char's corpse for Char's Smoldering Fist and 10-20 Garrison Resources.
Charbone is a burning plague-dog summoned by Lyandra Sunstrider in Icecrown Citadel during the third stage of The Frozen Flame.
Feyduster was a variety of enchanted short swords created on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR, with the original being the masterwork of the evil enchanter Nolls's twisted mind.
Chaotoids are voidwalkers located in the Arcing Depths and the Nightwell in the Nighthold.
Chargore is a magma giant located at the Molten Fields in the Firelands.
Charred Vanquishers are fire revenants located in the Molten Front.
Fey spears were a variety of enchanted polearms created on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR that originated from Neverwinter Wood's fey inhabitants.

__NOTOC__ Chef Fry-Aerie is a harpy located in a cave at the Bluefeather Cliffs in Thaldraszus. Rumor has it that she honed her craft by battling famous chefs up and down Kalimdor, eating them afterwards.

Chieftain Swiftspear is a taunka quest giver located in Frostfloe Deep in the northern Storm Peaks. Hundreds of years ago, Swiftspear was the chieftain of Camp Tunka'lo. His brother, Stormhoof, attempted to destroy the evil North Wind that had enslaved their people. After his death, Swiftspear was buried in Frostfloe Deep, the traditional burial ground of the people of Tunka'lo. The North Wind initiated its revenge by altering history, including Swiftspear's memories of his brother's fight against the elemental overlord. With the aid of adventurers, Swiftspear's spirit seeks to help restore the timeline to its proper setting by sealing off the distortions in time caused by the North Wind.
Chronalis, the Time Shifter, favored child of Nozdormu, is a level 61 elite drake of the bronze dragonflight. He guards the entrance to the Caverns of Time in eastern Tanaris together with Tick.
Fidius Finn was a ship captain and pirate smuggler, turned businessman, living in the city of Ravens Bluff in the 14 century DR.
__NOTOC__ Chromatic Elite Guards are chromatic dragonspawn found in Upper Blackrock Spire; two of them are the personal guards of General Drakkisath.
__NOTOC__ Chronomancer Phosildral is a nightborne located at the Life Vault Ruins in the Waking Shores. He is using Busy Brushes in his work.
Cleansed Spirits of Fire are bound fire elementals summoned by Kraga Tidefury. They are located in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.

Fine Armors of Bral was a small business in the city of Bral in the 14 century DR that specialized in selling repaired armor and weapons that had been salvaged from battlefields and spelljamming shipwrecks.
__NOTOC__ Cleff is a black dragonspawn located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores.
Cloudscraper is a wind serpent located in Island Expeditions.
Coilskar Witches are elite Coilskar naga located in the Magisters' Terrace. Susceptible to Mind Control.

Flanagus Gnarlybone was a gnome fighter and the tavernmaster of the Troll in Flames tavern in the settlement of Mornbryn's Shield around 1370 DR. He was gruff and rotund. He made sure to stock up on the favored drinks and brews of his bar's regulars.
